chapter_notes_tr: Köprüde Mahmut eski komutanıyla yüzleşir. Beşli auto-battle savaşında formasyon, savunma hattı ve hedef politikası öne çıkar; Fadyme'nin saçındaki beyaz tutam hastalığın ilerlemesini oyuncuya gösterir.

scenes.direction_en: A herald’s pennant appears through ravine mist. Marek recognizes the empty crest socket on Mahmut’s armor.

tutorial_cards_en.copy_en: Choose a policy before battle: protect low-HP allies, break boss parts, prioritize marked targets, or save Ultimates for a phase change.

pre_battle_lines.text_en: That socket used to carry a crown. The road has not forgotten.
The road remembers a version of me that no longer exists.
Good. Then it can remember this one too.

post_battle_lines.text_en: The refugees are across. I will carry your warning to the next watch post.
You sing as if the bridge is still standing.
A road is not a stone span. It is whoever agrees to walk it.

scenes.direction_en: Nara braces a narrow gate while two siege winches pull its chains tight.

tutorial_cards_en.copy_en: Front heroes and guard effects redirect pressure. A shield absorbs damage before HP is lost.

pre_battle_lines.text_en: The gate can hold for one minute. The winches can be stopped in ten seconds. Choose the faster danger.
You hold the civilians. We take the winches.
That is the right order. Do not make me repeat it.

post_battle_lines.text_en: The civilians are clear. I will stay with the gate until the last cart crosses.
You always put yourself between people and the fall.
Someone has to be the first thing the stone hits.

scenes.direction_en: Sable and Rikka slip into a signal tower while the party draws guards away from the bell rope.

tutorial_cards_en.copy_en: Auto Ultimate can be turned on or off at any time. Manual Ultimate remains available while ordinary attacks resolve automatically.

pre_battle_lines.text_en: I can break the door. I can also break the whole wall. Which one do you want?
The door. We are rescuing prisoners, not improving the view.
You make every plan sound less fun.

post_battle_lines.text_en: This order names Fadyme. The seal belongs to the old Crown Guard.
My commander signed it.
Then we ask him why.
If he answers honestly, I will be surprised.

scenes.direction_en: Odelia warns the party about mines. A bell pulse crosses the bridge; one lock of Fadyme’s ash-pale hair turns stark white, whiter than bone.

pre_battle_lines.text_en: The stones are hollow under the third span. Do not run when the bell rings.
I was not going to run.
Your voice changed. Are you hurt?

post_battle_lines.text_en: Only tired. The wind is colder here.
You have been tired since the forest.
Then I have been consistent.
Consistent is not the same as well.
She does not answer. For the first time, he does not let the question go, and for the first time, she has nothing ready.
A white strand. One more thing the mirror will remember before he does.

scenes.direction_en: Marshal Oren waits at the far end of the bridge with a shield line and Mahmut’s old crest painted upside down.

tutorial_cards_en.copy_en: Shield formations protect enemy Rear units. Focus the signal standard or use area attacks to open the line.

pre_battle_lines.text_en: I gave the order. I did not know the rite would hollow her out.
You knew enough to send men after her.
I thought the seal would save the kingdom without consuming its heir.
You thought a promise was the same as a plan.
Yseldra carried the order from the Inquisition. I signed it. That is the whole of my courage.

post_battle_lines.text_en: The Ashen estate has the full schedule. Go before the bridge falls.
You are coming with us.
No. Someone must keep this span open. I will not fail the people twice.
The white strand is small. I can still hide something small.

scenes.battle_transition_en: Oren stays to hold the bridge; Marek and Nara escort survivors, Rikka returns to her kiln company, and Sable advances toward the estate.

scenes.direction_en: Four days east. Refugees move the other way, carrying carts and children.

lines.text_en: Do not cross the old bridge. Soldiers on it. Crown colors, upside down.
A marshal's. They are looking for a woman with a bell pin.
Then she had better keep her hood up.
Crown colors, upside down. Oren always hated sloppy banners.

scenes.direction_en: Night on the far bank. Mahmut sits with his back to the bridge. Fadyme brings two cups of weak tea.

lines.text_en: You have not spoken since the span.
He taught me to hold a shield. He signed the order that made me drop it.
And tonight he held a bridge.
Does that make him better or worse?
It makes him a man who was late. You know how that feels.
For once, she kept watch, and he slept.
